rows.name: Clara | Australian Professional Female with Warmth & Trust
rows.text: On Thursday morning, I took the train to a small town near the coast. A friend met me at the station, and we walked past the old park to a cafe on the next street. I ordered water and a cup of coffee while she checked the weather. We planned to visit the market after lunch, but the rain arrived earlier than expected. Instead, we stayed inside and talked about a new project. By half past three, the sky was clear, so we collected our bags and headed back to the station.

rows.name: Clara | Australian Professional Female with Warmth & Trust
rows.text: On Friday afternoon, Sarah called the library to ask about a reading group. The meeting usually starts at four, but this week it will begin at half past five because the room is being repaired. Sarah will bring a notebook and a bottle of water. Her brother planned to drive her there, but his car is unavailable. She will take the bus instead and meet him after the discussion. The library is opposite the park, beside the corner shop.
